info.title: Reval API
info.description: Public API (/v1) for client packages, and the portal API (/portal).

post.description: Creates a run over a dataset version. The response tells the client how to execute it.

config.description: What is being tested, e.g. { model, temperature, promptVersion }

limit.description: Only run the first N items

trigger.description: Client info, e.g. { client: 'node', version: '0.1.0', ci: true }

url.description: Link to the run in the portal

timeoutMs.description: Abort each solver call after this long

concurrency.description: Recommended number of parallel solver calls

pollIntervalMs.description: Wait this long when a lease returns no tasks

post.description: Returns up to `max` tasks. Submit each result with its leaseId before leaseExpiresAt. When `tasks` is empty: stop if `done` is true, otherwise wait `retryAfterMs` and lease again (other clients still hold leases that may expire and be handed out again).

itemId.description: The dataset item's own id, if it had one

post.description: Send `output` for a success or `error` for a failure. Results with an unknown or stale lease are rejected.
